judgement.reason: Pretix is a Django web app with PostgreSQL and S3-capable media storage, so running gunicorn in a single process without supervisor is a contained change.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /data (Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The shown lines do not prove that /data holds only cache or temporary files, and pretix stores media uploads there by default, so the finding stands until you confirm that a setting moves this data to S3 or a database.
